the footer in the dark code window. Without it the footer stops at the API's time.

items.name: searches-page
items.title: Searches page
items.description: Searches as it ships, a page composition: every search an agent ran, newest first, with the page's one filter in its head. A row opens in place to what the agent read, its documents to download, and why a search went wrong with what to do about it.
items.use_for: Checking what search handed an agent, and finding the searches to fix.
never: A second filter: the outcome is the page's one
Opening a search in a panel: it opens under its row
Every row at once on a long log: twelve, then twelve more
items.source: conare-web app/pages/dashboard/searches.vue, app/components/console/searches/Log.vue, Simple.vue, Outcome.vue, Acts.vue, utils/searchLog.ts, app/assets/css/console2.css (.v2-table, .v2-rowgrow, .v2-logsimple, .v2-chev, .v2-more)
items.body:
`SearchesLog` is the table alone (rows with `question`, `agent`, `outcome`, `tookMs`, `when`, `passages`, and a `why`
and `fix` when a search went wrong); `SearchesPage` puts it under the page head with the filter (`v-model:show`) and
the empty state. The branch's other two takes (Trace, the list beside one search; Most asked, questions counted once)
are not ported.

items.name: section-head
items.title: Section head
items.description: How the website heads a page or a band: the red tag in the site's capitals, the line in Faculty Glyphic on 1.15 lines, one muted line and the one action under it. Centred, or started at the left beside its content.
items.use_for: The head of a website page (as h1) or of a band (as h2) that has no head of its own.
never: In the console: its pages use ConsolePage
Two actions in one head
A tag longer than a word or two
items.source: conare-web app/components/home/Tag.vue, app/pages/pricing.vue and blog/index.vue (the heads), Products.vue and Integrations.vue (the bands' heads)
items.body:
`as="h1"` for the page's own head; bands default to h2. Put a `button-link` in the `action` slot: the dark one with
`grain`, `pixels` and `arrow` for a page's one main call to action. `titleId` names the heading, so the band around it
can say `aria-labelledby`.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The hairline as its own part: 1px in the edge colour, across or down. Inset is the menu's, running out to the panel's edges with 4px of air above and below.
items.use_for: Between two parts of a card, between groups in a menu, between links in a row.
never: A shadow or a thicker rule to separate
A rule where spacing already separates

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings as the console draws it: one title and its parts as line tabs, switching in place, each part the settings table. General: the company's name to edit in place, its ID and when it joined, then Sign out. Members: who is in, with Invite members. Sign-in: each way in with its switch.
items.use_for: A console's settings. Start a console page from ConsoleFrame and ConsolePage.
never: A form page per setting: edits open in their row
More than one dark button: Invite members on Members, Save while editing
Calling the API from the component: it emits rename, invite, remove, toggle and signOut
items.source: conare-web app/components/console/settings/SettingsFrame.vue (take 3: the parts as tabs), app/pages/dashboard/settings/index.vue, members.vue, sign-in.vue
items.body:
`v-model:part` is the open tab (`general`, `members`, `sign-in`). The page draws on ConsolePage (from overview-page)
and Table's `settings` variant, whose last column of buttons is one width.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel at the right edge over a dimmed page, the console's docs panel: 420px, a hairline edge, the 48px bar with the title and a close button. It slides 16px in over 220ms and leaves in 160ms; Escape closes it at once and focus returns.
items.use_for: Reading or editing something beside the page without leaving it: docs, a document's details, a source's settings.
never: A short question or a confirmation: use Dialog or AlertDialog
Navigation on a phone: use Drawer
A shadow: the hairline edge and the scrim set it apart
items.source: conare-web app/assets/css/console2.css (.v2-docs, .v2-docs-bar, .v2-docs-body and their transitions; .v2-sheet-backdrop for the scrim). New in Conare's style: shadcn's sheet.
items.body:
`useSheet` is the slide-in behavior Sheet and Drawer share: a native modal dialog (focus stays inside, the page is
inert), the exit played before the dialog closes, Escape at once, focus back to the trigger.

The body scrolls under a fade (`fade-y`) at the edge with more past it.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer text
items.description: Words that say something is working: a lighter band runs across them for as long as the work does. Reduced motion shows them still.
items.use_for: A search or a sync under way, in the few words that say so.
never: Text that is already done
Whole sentences of body text
A shimmering block in place of a loading row (rows keep their layout)
items.body: The band runs right to left every 1.4s in the muted grey's lighter step. Remove it when the work ends, and put the sentence in `role="status"` so the change is read out. Pair it with the dot matrix (Loader) when the wait is long.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The console's navigation: a label over each group, a row with its icon and count, a red edge on the page you are on, and a count that turns red when something failed.
items.use_for: Moving between the console's pages. It stays open; on a phone the app shows it as a drawer over the page.
never: Counts that never change
A second level of rows: a page's own sections go in Tabs
items.body: The rows scroll under a fade (`fade-y`): an edge with more past it fades over 24px, so no row is ever cut off.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The website's foot on the dark gray under the grain: the mark and the line with the legal row under them, the link columns (each label rolling up to a copy of itself under the pointer), and the wordmark cut off by the page edge. Pinned, it waits under the page and is uncovered as the page scrolls off it.
items.use_for: Every page of the website.
never: In the console
Links that need more than a word or two

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: The website header: the logo, the Product menu and the links on the page's true center with a paper block gliding under them, the two buttons at the edge; below 768px a square button folds the links into a sheet.
items.use_for: The top of every website page.
never: A translucent bar: the red footer under the page would tint it
More than one dark button in it
items.body:
`actions` renders twice, in the bar and in the phone sheet (`place` says which). Mark where the reader is with a link's
`current`, or `product-current` while the products are on screen.

On a phone, a menu taller than the screen scrolls under a fade (`fade-y`).

items.name: site-page
items.title: Site page
items.description: Every website page's frame: the announcement bar if there is one, the header, the page in main on its own ground, and the footer pinned under it, uncovered as the page scrolls off it.
items.use_for: The frame of a website page. The page templates (home-page, pricing-page and the rest) are built on it.
never: In the console: use ConsoleFrame
A page without the footer: it is how the site leads on
A second header inside main
items.source: conare-web app/pages/index.vue, pricing.vue and blog/index.vue (the .home frame: AnnouncementBar, Header, main over the pinned Footer)
items.body:
`header` takes SiteHeader's props (`items`, `more`, `links`, `homeHref`, `homeLabel`), `footer` SiteFooter's (`columns`,
`tagline`, `legal`, `legalLinks`) and `announcement` AnnouncementBar's. The `logo` and `actions` slots go to the header;
`actions` renders twice, in the bar and in the phone sheet (`place` says which; in web components put the buttons in
`actions` and again in `sheet-actions`). The page goes in the default slot.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading that is never empty: a held part is the real part drawn from a blank record, its layout and rules kept and its content hidden, so nothing moves when the answer lands. The rules come in after 300ms, so a fast answer never shows them.
items.use_for: Table rows, cards and lists while their data loads. The dot matrix beside a word for work that takes longer.
never: A shimmer block or gray bars
A layout that jumps when the data lands
Showing the rules before 300ms

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a range: the meter's 4px track with ink up to the value and a square 12px ink thumb.
items.use_for: A number where the range matters more than the exact figure: passages per search, a minimum score.
never: Exact values a person would rather type (use Input)
A round or growing thumb
Animating the thumb: it follows the hand
items.source: New in Conare's style: the meter's track (console2.css .v2-meter), the switch's square thumb and red focus (.v2-switch)
items.body: A native range input, so arrows, Page Up and Down, Home and End work. `v-model` is the number; `min`, `max` and `step` as usual; `label` names it and `valueText` reads a formatted value. Show the value beside it in tabular figures. The row is 28px (40px on phones) and takes the pointer anywhere along it.

items.name: source-row
items.title: Source row
items.description: A source as getting started lists it: its app's mark and name, linking to the source, then its sync's state as a tag, and with detail its last and next sync.
items.use_for: Lists of sources: getting started, a namespace's sources, a sidebar note.
never: A source without its app's mark
Red for anything but a failed sync
items.body:
`AppMark` draws an app's logo when you pass `logo`, otherwise a square tile with its initial; the library ships no
third-party logos. Word `synced` and `next` in the reader's terms ("2 hours ago").

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A label over a number in a row of stats, split by hairlines. A stat that drives a chart is a button: it fills with the paper under the pointer, and the pinned one stays filled with a red edge on top.
items.use_for: The few numbers a card is about: queries this month, today, latency.
never: More than four in a row
A stat with no unit or period

items.name: step-viz
items.title: Step window
items.description: How it works' window: one search shown step by step as an agent window, from the ask to what changed, with a shimmering status, records as chips, the dot matrix and a ticking timer; picking a step crossfades what is in it.
items.use_for: How it works and the docs' introduction (`step` 0 to 3; `runs` replays the picked one).
never: Steps that do not happen in the product
Running while off screen: set `active` only while it is in view

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Steps that open one at a time: the one to do is the only open thing, a finished step folds to a line that says what came of it, and a step not reached is dimmed and locked.
items.use_for: A short job done in order on one page, such as sending data by API or setting up single sign-on.
never: Steps that could be done in any order
More than five
items.body:
`useSteps()` keeps the state: `state(n)` for each Step, `reach(n)` when a step is done (it opens the next), `toggle(n)`
on a head's `open`, `reset()` to start again.

items.name: subprocessor-table
items.title: Subprocessor table
items.description: The subprocessors as a policy page's ruled table in the double rule: who, what for, what data and where, each name linking to its data-processing terms in the red.
items.use_for: The subprocessors page and the privacy policy's list.
never: Vendors not on the signed list
How the product works (models, engines, which call goes where)
items.body: A wide table scrolls sideways under a fade (`fade-x`); its frame and outline stay whole.

items.name: suggestion-chips
items.title: Suggestion chips
items.description: Questions to start from under the search box, each ending on the namespace that answers it; a block glides to the one pointed at.
items.use_for: Home, before anything is asked.
never: Questions the data cannot answer
More than one row on a desktop
items.body: `items` are `{ q, ns, logo? }`: the question, the namespace and the app's 10px mark. Picking one emits `ask` with it. The paper block glides on transform and size in 160ms on the console's curve, placed without a glide the first time the pointer arrives, and fades in 120ms when it leaves. The tag under it goes a shade darker. The branch's other two takes (the pixel fill and the roll) were not picked and are not ported.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off with no words: a square thumb in a square track. The row beside it says what the state means. Black when on, grey while it can't be changed.
items.use_for: A setting that is on or off, such as email sign-in.
never: On and Off written beside it
A switch with no line saying what it does

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of one kind of thing: a paper head in sentence case, 40px rows, numbers in tabular figures, IDs in mono, and a status column of tags. Settings and the audit log share one plainer table with buttons one width.
items.use_for: Namespaces, sources, keys, members, the audit log.
never: A table for one subject with a chart (use Card)
Capitals in heads
A scroll box a keyboard can't reach
items.body: Framed, the rows scroll sideways under a fade (`fade-x`); the hairline frame stays whole.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A few views of one thing: line tabs for a page's sections (an ink underline and a red square on the current one) and the segmented control for a chart's view or range, its white block gliding to the pick.
items.use_for: Documents and Settings on a namespace; Volume and Latency on a chart; 1h, 24h and 7d.
never: Actions (use Button)
More than six views (use Menu)
Bold on the current tab: the underline marks it

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind. In the console: ready in a hairline, syncing in black with the dot matrix, failed in the red wash with its square, quiet notes in grey. On the website: 10px capitals on the red.
items.use_for: A source's status, an organization's "default", an invite's "invited"; the website's section labels.
never: Colour alone: the word carries the state
Capitals in the console
A tag as a button

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: One customer's words in the website's double rule: the tag, the quote in Faculty Glyphic, centred and balanced, then who said it: the company's square initial, the role and the company.
items.use_for: One quote on a home or product page, from a customer who agreed to it.
never: An invented person: attribute a quote to a role at the company
A carousel of quotes
Stars or ratings
items.source: No equivalent in conare-web; set from the website's rules: the FAQ's double rule (Faq.vue), the section tag (Tag.vue), Faculty Glyphic for display text, the square avatar (AccountMenu.vue)

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text swap
items.description: Two labels in one cell, so nothing around them moves: the first leaves up, the next arrives from below with a touch of blur, and a check draws its stroke.
items.use_for: A button or a status that changes its words in place: Copy prompt to Copied, Connect to Connected.
never: Labels of very different lengths: the cell takes the longer and the button would look loose
More than two states (use FixButton's stacked states)
items.body: `on` picks the label: the `a` slot when false, `b` when true. The leaving label fades and blurs over 160ms while it moves 5px in 220ms on the strong ease-out; a Lucide check in `b` draws its stroke after 40ms. The hidden label is `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader reads the current one. Reduced motion keeps the cross-fade only.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text: 13px on 20px lines, the hairline that darkens on hover and turns to a 2px ink edge on focus, red when invalid.
items.use_for: Pasted text, a note, a description. Put it in a Field.
never: A question to search (use the search box)
A red border at rest
Under 16px on phones
items.body: `v-model` is the text, `rows` the height (4), `invalid` the red edge. Focus thickens the edge to 2px while the padding gives a pixel back, so the text does not move. It grows by hand downward only.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short note at the bottom right saying what just happened: black, for four seconds, three at most. Pointing at one holds them, and a hidden tab stops their time.
items.use_for: Confirming something that left the screen: a deleted document.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
What the page already shows

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Options that stay pressed on the segmented control's track, several at once or one that can be let go.
items.use_for: Kinds of document a search returns; an ordering that can be turned off.
never: Views of one thing (use Tabs)
Actions (use Button or ButtonGroup)
items.body: Tabs' look with `aria-pressed` buttons in a labelled group. `multiple` makes the model an array of values; otherwise it is one value or null, and pressing the pressed one lets it go. With one at most, the white block glides to the pick in 180ms where the browser has anchor positioning. A new file beside Tabs, which stays as it is.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A pressable chip that stays on: a red square at its start and an ink edge while it is on.
items.use_for: One option in a row of options or filters: exact words, include archived.
never: A setting saved at once (use Switch)
A pick of one from several (use ToggleGroup or Tabs)
items.body: `v-model` is pressed or not (`aria-pressed`). On hover the 4px red square shows and the edge goes ink; while on, both stay. A press gives the paper fill. 40px on phones.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: An icon button's name in the inverse fill, 11px, under its trigger: 300ms wait under the pointer, at once on keyboard focus, 125ms in. Right after another tooltip it shows at once.
items.use_for: Naming icon buttons in rows and toolbars.
never: Anything someone needs to read or act on: put it on the page
A tooltip on a button that already has a label
Showing on touch: a tap presses the button
items.source: conare-web app/components/console/Copy.vue (version 1's tip, .v2-copy1-tip). New in Conare's style: shadcn's tooltip, on usePopover so it flips and stays inside the viewport.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top bar
items.description: The 48px bar over every console page: breadcrumbs, each step back a link, the page itself in ink, a namespace in mono. Its crumbs are the breadcrumb.
items.use_for: Saying where you are and the way back, over every console page.
never: Repeating the page's title as a heading right under it
Actions that belong to the page: they go in the page's head
items.body:
`Breadcrumb` is shadcn's breadcrumb: pass `items` (`label`, `href`, `mono`), the last is the page. Give `as` your router
link (`NuxtLink`) to navigate without a reload.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The console's type as one reference: a 20px Faculty Glyphic page title, Geist at 13px for everything else, 12px meta, 11px captions, Geist Mono for keys and IDs, a link with a quiet underline and a query's words in medium weight.
items.use_for: Any text in the console. Prefer the type-* utilities in markup; Text is the same set as a component.
never: Bold (600 and up) weights
Capitals in the console
Text lighter than the meta gray
A marked word with a fill: weight only
items.body:
In the web component, the variant's colour and type hold over the page's own styles, so `<conare-text>` looks right
in an app that only adds components. To give one a different colour, size or line height, set `--type-color`,
`--type-size` or `--type-leading` on it (for example
`class="[--type-color:var(--ds-color-fg-soft)]"`); a colour class such as `text-fg-soft` does not reach it. These
don't pass down, so a marked word inside keeps its own look.

items.name: work-panel
items.title: Card and dark panel
items.description: A card beside the dark panel in the website's double rule: the title with its red full stop, one line and the one action; on the panel the grain, a sheet of cells and one small window that plays once.
items.use_for: A page whose job is one action with a visible result: Getting started, Agents, Send by API.
never: Two dark panels on one page
A window that replays on hover: it plays once
More than one dark button in the card
items.body:
Put one window in the `window` slot: one of the website's product windows (`step-viz`, `eval-viz`, `product-viz`,
`price-viz`) as Getting started does, or `WorkWindow`, the console's own small dark window (a bar with its title and a
tag, the body, a foot line whose square turns red when the work is done), for work the app runs itself.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace switcher
items.description: The sidebar head's organization switcher: the brand mark, the organization over its customer and role, and a menu of every organization grouped by customer, the current one checked, then New organization, settings and members.
items.use_for: Sidebar's head slot, wherever a person reaches more than one organization.
never: Switching without saying which organization is opening
A round avatar: organizations are square tiles
items.body:
v-model is the current organization's id; set `switching` to the id while the app opens it (the row reads "opening"
and the others wait), and `error` if that fails. Put the brand mark in the `mark` slot.

items.name: written-answer
items.title: Written answer
items.description: The written answer above the passages, on the paper with a red edge: the words at 16px citing their sources as small ink squares. Answer first shows it by itself; on request is one button, since it costs a second query; beside the page sets the cited page next to the words.
items.use_for: A search that asks for an answer with citations, above Search results.
never: An answer without its sources
Holding the passages until the answer is written: they land first
A spinner: the dot matrix and Writing an answer
